rain_ripples_normal.png.layout: 4x4 flipbook, 16 frames of 512x512, row-major from top-left; loops (frame 15 -> 0); each frame tiles. OpenGL tangent normals, flat = (128,128,255).

footprints_alpha.png.layout: 4 cols x 2 rows of 256x512 cells, toe towards the top of the image (+V); sole ~0.295 m ~= 340 px (1150 px/m, cell = 0.22 x 0.445 m). RGB = OpenGL normal of the depression, A = decal mask. Cells (row-major): left_fresh_deep, right_fresh_deep, left_shallow, right_shallow, left_slipped_smeared, right_toe_only, left_heel_only, right_old_softened.

smoke_puff.png.layout: single sprite, straight alpha, RGB light-grey self-shadowed shading (never black in transparent texels; safe to premultiply).

dust_puff.png.layout: single sprite, tan/brown dust, softer & wispier, straight alpha.

cloud_noise.png.layout: tileable; R = broad fbm masses, G = ridged/billow mid detail, B = fine cellular wisps. Linear data.

water_normal.png.layout: tileable small wind-wave normal map (OpenGL), Phillips spectrum, designed for ~2 m tile.

grass_blade_atlas.png.layout: 4 cols x 2 rows of 256x512 cells; each a dead/autumn grass tuft card with its base at the bottom centre of the cell; sRGB colour, alpha-tested (A>0.5); colours dilated into transparent texels.

fire_flipbook.png.layout: 8x8 flipbook, 64 frames of 256x256, row-major from the top left, loops (frame 63 -> 0). RGB = emissive flame colour (sRGB, use additively or as emissive), A = flame mask; flame base at the bottom centre of each frame.

smoke_dark.png.layout: single dense dark smoke puff (burning buildings), straight alpha, self-shadowed dark grey-brown RGB.

window_tape.png.layout: whole texture = one window pane: brown gummed anti-blast paper tape (border, X and centre cross), straight alpha ~0.85, transparent elsewhere.

glass_shards.png.layout: decal of scattered broken window glass on the ground: faint greenish bodies, bright edges and glints in RGB, A = coverage. Not tileable.

barbed_wire_alpha.png.layout: horizontal strip tiling along U: two twisted strands with a 4-point barb every 128 px (~0.1 m if the strip is 0.4 m long).
